title: Understanding Gradient Descent
text: When using stochastic gradient descent, the estimated gradient is calculated using a subset of the data. How might this affect the accuracy of the gradient compared to using the entire dataset?

title: True Gradient vs. Estimated Gradient
text: Consider how the true gradient is calculated. It involves the entire dataset, while the estimated gradient in stochastic gradient descent uses only a sample. What implications does this have for their equality?

title: Comparing Gradients
text: Which of the following statements is true about the estimated gradient in stochastic gradient descent?
choices: The estimated gradient is always equal to the true gradient
The estimated gradient is always greater than the true gradient
The estimated gradient is always less than the true gradient
The estimated gradient is an approximation of the true gradient
